verdict.rationale: Ente Auth does not let you pick a cloud region, but it gives you control over where data lives in other ways. You can self-host the server and point Auth at your own machine (docs-15), with the server confirmed open source (probe-rt-2). You can also run offline with codes stored only on the device (docs-7, docs-37), and save encrypted local backups to a location you choose (docs-10). Missing for 10: region/residency selection for Ente's hosted cloud sync, documentation of where hosted data is stored, independent corroboration of self-hosting Auth.
